questions.stem: The brief says 'Der Architekt geht in das Büro.' Which case follows in?

options.text: Dative, because in is always dative.
Nominative, because it is the subject.
Genitive, because of the definite article.

questions.explanation: Two-way prepositions take accusative with motion and dative with location. Ignoring motion is the error.
